filter.data-note: Use it through `.glass .glass--liquid` (backdrop-filter), not as an `.fx-` class.
filter.title: Refractive glass
filter.desc: Displaces the backdrop through a smooth noise lens so content behind the pane bends; other browsers get a frosted fallback.

feTurbulence.data-tweak-baseFrequency: Lens frequency, horizontal and vertical; lower gives larger, smoother bends
